# Battle Card: CarBot Cloud CXM

**Generated by**: /sales-enablement
**Date**: 2026-02-26
**Classification**: Tier B — Sales Conversation Only

---

## Quick Positioning

**In one sentence**: CXM is the free, AI-native platform that unifies every dealer communication and service in the interface each team member already knows.

**In 10 seconds**: "CXM puts every call, text, and lead in one place. AI handles the follow-through. Your team picks the interface. It's free for CarBot clients."

---

## Us vs. Them

| Capability | CarBot CXM | Bolt-On AI (Impel, etc.) | CRM Native (VIN/eLead) | Call Tracking (Car Wars) |
|-----------|-----------|------------------------|----------------------|----------------------|
| Unified conversation view | All channels in one timeline | Notes pushed to CRM | Leads only — no calls | Calls only — no leads |
| AI workflow execution | AI agents execute workflow steps | AI engages, humans follow up | Rules engine, no AI agents | No workflow capability |
| Interface customization | ~20 generational themes | Single UI | Single UI | Single UI |
| Real-time call visibility | Live streaming + transcription | No | No | Post-call analysis |
| Auto-task completion | AI watchers complete CRM tasks | Push notes only | Manual task completion | No task management |
| Pricing | Free for CarBot clients | Separate subscription | Included with CRM | Separate subscription |
| Compliance depth | 10DLC + CNAM + STIR/SHAKEN + PII redaction | Varies | Basic | Call recording compliance |

## When They Say / You Say

### "We already have a CRM."
**You say**: "CXM doesn't replace it. It sits on top. Your CRM stays your system of record — CXM just shows everything in one place and pushes all actions back. Think of it as the windshield, not the engine."

### "We're already using Impel."
**You say**: "Impel pushes notes into your CRM. Does it schedule the appointment after the call? Does it complete the task? CXM doesn't just engage — it follows through."
[EVIDENCE: transcript BDC-Pros-Extended 27:30-27:42]

### "How is this free?"
**You say**: "CXM makes every other CarBot service more valuable. When your AI agents, your call tracking, and your workflows all live in one place, you use more of what you already pay for. The platform earns its place."

### "My team won't use another tool."
**You say**: "That's exactly why we built 20 interfaces. Your GM gets Outlook. Your 23-year-old BDC rep gets Discord. Nobody learns something new — they use what they already know."

### "We don't trust AI to talk to our customers."
**You say**: "You define every word. You pick the voice, the personality, the rules, the handoff points. And every call streams live — you can listen in and take over any time. It's not a black box."

### "What about compliance?"
**You say**: "10DLC, CNAM, STIR/SHAKEN — all standard. PII redaction on every transcript. The architecture was built for HIPAA. Ask other vendors which of those they include."

### "We just acquired new stores — we can't change things right now."
**You say**: "CXM is how you manage them remotely without disrupting them locally. Start with the Outlook view — it looks like email. Your new staff sees something familiar. Layer in AI when they're ready."
[EVIDENCE: transcript MAP-Buying-Center 22:52-24:04]

## Landmines to Plant

Ask your prospect to ask any vendor:
1. "Can your AI agents execute workflow steps, or do they just generate notes?" — Most can't. CXM can.
2. "Can different team members see different interfaces?" — Nobody else offers generational UI.
3. "Show me a PII-redacted transcript that still has useful context." — Most redaction is blunt. Ours is smart.
4. "What happens after a call ends? Does anything update automatically?" — CXM's AI watcher completes CRM tasks.

## Disqualifying Criteria (Walk Away)

- Dealer has no existing CarBot service and doesn't want one (CXM is free with services — no standalone sale)
- Dealer is mid-CRM migration and won't stabilize for 6+ months
- Dealer's IT team blocks all third-party API access
- Decision-maker wants guaranteed ROI numbers (we don't have production data yet)
